text:
Ammonia, hypoxanthine and uric acid are the ADP degradation products that rise in the blood during repeated-sprint exercise. ADP is converted to AMP, which AMP deaminase turns into IMP and releases ammonia, and IMP is then broken down through inosine and hypoxanthine to uric acid. Urea and creatinine are not products of ADP degradation, so my earlier answer was incomplete because it left out ammonia.

CONFIDENCE: 80
